import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer, TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
import xgboost as xgb
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission_null.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
df_sample = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

print(
    f"Train rows: {len(df_train)}, Test rows: {len(df_test)}, Sample submission rows: {len(df_sample)}"
)


# Clean text function with enhanced normalization
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip().strip('"').strip("'").replace("\\n", " ").lower()
    return text.replace("\n", " ")


# Apply text cleaning
df_train["text"] = df_train.apply(
    lambda row: clean_text(row.get("Comment", "")), axis=1
)
df_test["text"] = df_test.apply(lambda row: clean_text(row.get("Comment", "")), axis=1)

# Extract features and labels from training data
X_train_full = df_train["text"].values
y_train_full = df_train["Insult"].values

print(
    f"Full training vectors shape: {X_train_full.shape}, Labels: {y_train_full.shape}"
)

# Proper train/validation split (use same split for everything consistent)
X_train, X_val, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

print(f"Train set: {len(X_train)}, Val set: {len(X_val)}")

# Dual-vectorizer approach: count (local patterns) + tfidf (global importance)
count_vec = CountVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=1)
tfidf_vec = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english")

# Fit and transform ALL training data including validation
X_count_train = count_vec.fit_transform(X_train)
X_tfidf_train = tfidf_vec.fit_transform(X_train)
X_count_val = count_vec.transform(X_val)
X_tfidf_val = tfidf_vec.transform(X_val)
X_test_counts = count_vec.transform(df_test["text"])
X_test_tfidf = tfidf_vec.transform(df_test["text"])

# Stack features together
X_train_vec = hstack([X_count_train, X_tfidf_train])
X_val_vec = hstack([X_count_val, X_tfidf_val])
X_test_vec = hstack([X_test_counts, X_test_tfidf])

print(f"Training vectors shape: {X_train_vec.shape}")
print(f"Validation vectors shape: {X_val_vec.shape}")
print(f"Test vectors shape: {X_test_vec.shape}")

# Train Base Models on TRAIN SET ONLY (not val!)
xgb_model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    use_label_encoder=False,
    eval_metric="logloss",
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    n_estimators=500,
    verbose=0,
    tree_method="hist",
    missing=np.nan,
    random_state=42,
)

lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=6,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)

# Train both models on training split
xgb_model.fit(X_train_vec.toarray(), y_train_split)
lgb_model.fit(X_train_vec.toarray(), y_train_split)

# Get base model predictions for validation set ONLY
xgb_pred_proba = xgb_model.predict_proba(X_val_vec.toarray())[:, 1].reshape(-1, 1)
lgb_pred_proba = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val_vec.toarray())[:, 1].reshape(-1, 1)

# Stack: concatenate base predictions with original FEATURES ON VALIDATION SET
X_stacked_val = np.hstack([xgb_pred_proba, lgb_pred_proba, X_val_vec.toarray()])
y_stacked_val = y_val_split

# Train Meta-learner (LightGBM works better for stacking) on VALIDATION data only
meta_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=6,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)

meta_model.fit(X_stacked_val, y_stacked_val)

# Evaluate on VALIDATION set (never shown during training of final model)
meta_pred_proba_val = meta_model.predict_proba(X_stacked_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, meta_pred_proba_val)
print(f"AUC-ROC on Hold-Out Validation Set: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate final predictions on test data
xgb_test_proba = xgb_model.predict_proba(X_test_vec.toarray())[:, 1].reshape(-1, 1)
lgb_test_proba = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_test_vec.toarray())[:, 1].reshape(-1, 1)

# Stack test predictions
X_test_stacked = np.hstack([xgb_test_proba, lgb_test_proba, X_test_vec.toarray()])
final_pred_proba = meta_model.predict_proba(X_test_stacked)[:, 1]

# Create submission file matching sample format
df_submission = df_sample.copy()
df_submission.loc[0 : len(df_test) - 1, "Insult"] = final_pred_proba.tolist()
df_submission.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)

print("Submission file saved to:", SUBMISSION_PATH)
print("Final AUC-ROC on Validation Set:", val_auc)
print(f"Saved {len(final_pred_proba)} predictions to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
